What if you carried your bag on one shoulder every day?
Carrying a bag on one shoulder is a classic school habit. It's quick and easy. Lots of students carry heavy books this way.

But here's the twist. Your body leans to balance the weight, straining your neck, shoulder and back, so experts say keep a backpack under about ten percent of your body weight. Use both straps and pack the heaviest things closest to your back. Heavy bags carried the wrong way are a common cause of back pain in kids.
